cases.discussion: An ML platform lead describes measuring retrieval accuracy, first-token latency, and hallucination rates before rolling a support assistant into production. They ask peers which evaluation sets catch failures missed by aggregate benchmarks.
A local office shares photos from its annual costume lunch and asks employees to vote for the best table decorations. No business problem, method, result, or professional question is discussed.

An operations leader says the team loses time switching between separate scheduling and reporting tools. One commenter asks how the lost time is measured. Another recommends establishing a baseline before automating. No vendor, budget, or measured result is provided.

A founder claims a four-day week doubled productivity. A commenter agrees, while another asks for the team size, measurement period, and definition of productivity. The founder supplies none of those details.
